build_counter_agent: build a simuleval speech-to-text agent that counts audio duration and outputs it in the target language
run_counter_agent: run the CounterInTargetLanguage agent with a specified wait-seconds argument to process audio input
test_policy_method: test the policy method that reads audio source and returns ReadAction or WriteAction based on duration
review_add_args_method: review the add_args static method that registers the --wait-seconds CLI argument
summarize_counter_agent: summarize the CounterInTargetLanguage class that extends SpeechToTextAgent to output audio length in target language
